authority: Builders Association of India (BAI) Tamil Nadu Centre & Real Estate Regulatory Authority (TNRERA) Guidelines

packages.name: DTCP / CMDA & Local Body Plan Sanction
packages.description: Building plan scrutiny fee, infrastructure development charges, vacant land tax clearance, online single-window processing, and sanction order.

packages.name: TANGEDCO / TNEB 3-Phase Electrical Service Connection
packages.description: 3-phase meter board installation, development fee, meter security deposit, TNEB temporary construction supply conversion to permanent residential tariff.

packages.name: Borewell Drilling (300 ft) & 1.5 HP Submersible Pump
packages.description: Drilling up to 300 ft in Tamil Nadu hard rock/gravel, 7-inch heavy PVC casing pipe up to rock head, 1.5 HP stainless steel submersible pump, delivery pipe, and automatic water level controller.

packages.name: Underground RCC Sump (8,000L) & Bio-Septic Tank
packages.description: Excavation and casting of 8,000-litre waterproofed RCC drinking water sump tank, plus two-compartment masonry/precast septic tank with percolation soak pit.

packages.name: Compound Wall (140 R.ft) & Wrought Iron Main Gate
packages.description: 5-foot high boundary compound wall using 6-inch solid blocks with RCC stiffener columns every 10 ft, cement plastering, exterior paint, and a 12-ft wide designer iron entrance gate.

packages.name: Soil Investigation & Structural Engineering Design
packages.description: Standard Penetration Test (SPT) soil bore test report, safe bearing capacity (SBC) calculation, complete structural RCC drawings (footing, column, plinth, lintel, slab rebar schedules) with stability certificate.

packages.name: Mandatory Rainwater Harvesting (RWH) Percolation Pit
packages.description: 10-foot deep brick-lined recharge shaft with 40mm aggregate and coarse sand filter bed connected to roof drainage channels as required by Tamil Nadu municipal bye-laws.
